description.text: Through one academic year ( Fall and Spring Semesters, 36 weeks in total) of study, students can have a good command of Chinese in listening, speaking, reading and writing, and achieve the entry level of bachelor's programs (offered in Chinese) at School of International Education BUU. Condition of Completion Students who have completed all the courses and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion from School of International Education of Beijing Union University. Application Period All year round.

duration.text: The Regular Chinese Language Course at Beijing Union University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2166 USD/per year ￥ 15600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Letter of guardian’s guarantee For applicant under 18 years of age Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).

requirements.text: 1.Good Health 2.Applicant whose age is under 18 needs to submit notarial deed of guardianship
